note: Both sets correctly capture the damping values (3%, 3%, 6%), the s-coordinate endpoints, the composite-layer definition, and the flatback trailing-edge definition, and both contain the same fabricated quote ('3%, 5%, and 6%') supporting three damping claims, including a wrong 5% edgewise value.
